'''Hovhee''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew with [[Grace Command]], a mercy organization affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Grace Command was officially a relief organization led by the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Lemayne]] which fought the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warlords and distribute food and medicine to Sith-occupied worlds. In reality, Grace Command's real mission was to disseminate the narcotic [[Deluge]] into Sith territory. Hovhee was a member of [[Devil Squadron]], which was commanded by the former [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]]. Hovhee took part in the [[Aquilaris campaign]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. While traveling to [[Heptooine]], he and his fellow Devils were led into a trap by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Zodoh]]. Hovhee took part in the pursuit only to be caught by the Hutt warship ''[[Voracious]]'s'' [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]]. Later, Hovhee was presumably killed when Zodoh exposed Devaad's men to space through the airlocks.<ref name="KED2">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 2|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 2]]</ref>
